fresh_setup_layout.note: Fresh isolated setup selected MAX4 and Bambu A1; Prepare visible at original window dimensions before maximization, without debugger or resize recovery.

blank_key_connect.note: Native address dialog accepts blank optional API key; connected fixture reports two Boxes.

cancel_reopen_connect.note: Cancel returns to Device; reopening presents usable native address/key/CA fields before successful connect.

no_printer_controls.note: Device controls disabled with no configured printer.

clean_restart_endpoint.note: Restart restores full HTTP loopback endpoint including port and blank optional API key; live Box telemetry reconnects.

box_reopen_10.note: Ten Box editor cycles, usable geometry and one visible editor each.

external_reopen_10.note: Ten external editor cycles, usable geometry and one visible editor each.

slot_switch_colors.note: Each Box reopen switches slots; red/blue/green/white swatches match the selected slot. External swatch is gray.

material_and_rgb_edit.note: Fixture recorded expected command: UPDATE_FILAMENT_INFORMATION SLOT=0 COLOR='123456' VENDOR='Generic' FILAMENT='ABS'

duplicate_open.note: Three rapid open clicks leave exactly one visible material editor.

disconnect_open_dialog.note: Open editor survives WS disconnect; attempted confirm receives HTTP503, then new editor works after recovery.

reconnect_dialog.note: Fresh editor after reconnection has correct QIDI PLA Rapido and current slot color.

removed_slot_reject.note: A1 editor stayed open while reported Box count became zero; Confirm emitted no command.

close_with_pending_response.note: Material request arrived before a subsequent editor closed; delayed response completed after close, then a fresh green-slot editor remained usable.

four_boxes_slot15.note: Fixture recorded expected command: LOAD_FILAMENT_CONTROL SLOT=15

zero_boxes.note: Zero Boxes hides Box slots; external-spool material editor remains available.

external_display.note: External Generic PETG gray swatch shown with zero Boxes; material Confirm dispatched SLOT=16.

load_unload_eject.note: Fixture recorded expected command: EJECT_FILAMENT_CONTROL SLOT=15

rfid_refresh.note: Fixture recorded expected command: READ_RFID SLOT=15

rfid_preferences.note: Startup and insertion RFID toggles recorded their respective setting commands, ending both off.

chamber.note: Fixture recorded expected command: SET_HEATER_TEMPERATURE HEATER=chamber TARGET=50

part_aux_chamber_fans.note: Usable fan popup; three individual fan edits dispatched expected named fan commands.

lamp.note: Fixture recorded expected command: SET_PIN PIN=caselight VALUE=1

detection_sensitivity.note: Spaghetti high-sensitivity and disable plus foreign-object disable requests recorded.

box_v2_hides_eject.note: After box_v2 telemetry settles, Eject is hidden; restored box_v1 permits physical B2 operations.

malformed_json.note: Injected malformed-json followed by responsive GUI and a recorded lamp request.

wrong_type_box.note: Injected wrong-box-type followed by responsive GUI and a recorded lamp request.

null_slot_metadata.note: Injected null-material followed by responsive GUI and a recorded lamp request.

extreme_temperature.note: Injected extreme-temperature followed by responsive GUI and a recorded lamp request.

partial_metadata.note: Injected partial-metadata followed by responsive GUI and a recorded lamp request.

http_error.note: HTTP503 injected for controls; subsequent successful requests and telemetry recovered.

delayed_repeated_controls.note: Three fast lamp clicks with two-second response delay left Prepare responsive; GUI may coalesce clicks. Successful MAX4 slice/preview followed.

websocket_recovery.note: Forced WebSocket disconnect followed by a new object subscription and displayed updated chamber31C telemetry.

camera_valid.note: Valid labeled fixture JPEG renders in Device.

camera_invalid.note: Invalid JPEG response leaves GUI alive; subsequent camera recovery verified.

camera_http_recovery.note: Camera recovers after HTTP503 and malformed image injection.

delayed_shutdown_restart.note: POST arrival confirmed before shutdown with 15s injected latency; app exits0 less than1s after discard while request still pending, then restarts and reconnects.

original_sparse_import_slice_preview.note: Original QIDI sparse project imports without editing its embedded machine, retains three project filaments and slices/preview tool2.

sparse_T2_slot5_submit.note: GUI filament3 maps B2; upload retains T2 and preparation tool2; pre-start sends enable_box1 and value_t2 slot5.

reversed_multiple_box_mapping.note: T0 maps B2 physical5 and T2 maps A1 physical0; both assignments precede start.

support_first_import_slice_preview.note: Original QIDI support-first project imports unchanged and previews both used logical filaments0 and2.

support_first_T2_T0_both_mapped.note: Preparation stays tool2; first deposition tool0 then tool2; both have physical mappings.

external_single_submit.note: Single-used-tool sparse job mapped Ext sends enable_box0 without Box assignments and starts only after configuration.

incomplete_mapping_reject.note: Missing support-tool mapping disables Send and emits no POST.

mixed_external_reject.note: Mixed T0 Box and T2 external mapping disables Send and emits no POST.

multicolor_external_reject.note: Both used tools mapped external; explanatory message and disabled Send persist across ten seconds of refresh and attempted click, with no POST.

batch_qidi_reject.note: Experimental batch action explicitly refuses QIDI before dispatch.

stale_object_reject.note: Object chooser opened on fixture.gcode; status changed to replacement.gcode before Confirm; no EXCLUDE_OBJECT dispatched.

fresh_object_accept.note: Fresh chooser on replacement job dispatched exactly one EXCLUDE_OBJECT NAME=fixture_cube.

timelapse_enable.note: Native timelapse On is disabled despite MAX4 profile is_support_timelapse=1 and available storage. Shared canEnableTimelapse reads a Bambu support flag never populated by QIDI. Patch70 uses QIDI profile capability with existing Moonraker storage gate.

bed_level_polar_options.note: Changing bed leveling and polar cooler to Off is captured with the job and dispatches G32 plus enable_polar_cooler0 before start; earlier On produced G31 and1.

box_temperature_save_reload.note: Saved GUI 3MF retains Box temperatures35/40/45 and QIDI identity; reopening and exporting emits VT2=45, prep2 and only T2.

slice_after_controls.note: MAX4 cube slices and renders preview after all control, telemetry, HTTP, WebSocket and delayed-editor cases.

non_qidi_profile_slice.note: Unmodified Bambu A1 profile imports local cube through native file chooser, slices and renders G-code preview on exact candidate69.

file_chooser.note: Native import/open/save/export file choosers work with fresh isolated settings.
